title: Semidegree threshold for spanning trees in oriented graphs
summary: We show that for all $γ> 0$ and $Δ\in \mathbb{N}$, there is some $n_0$ such that, if $n \geq n_0$, then every oriented graph on $n$ vertices with minimum semidegree at least $(3/8 + γ)n$ contains a copy of each oriented tree on $n$ vertices with maximum degree at most $Δ$. This is asymptotically best possible.
